name: Jnani Debashis Mishra/ ଜ୍ଞାନୀ ଦେବାଶିଷ ମିଶ୍ର

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Jnani Debashis Mishra, also published as Jnanee Debasish Mishra, is an Odia poet and literary scholar associated with Ravenshaw University. His poetry collection Daaga received the Sahitya Akademi Yuva Puraskar in 2016. His critical writing includes work on comparative literature, bringing the study of literary relationships alongside his own creative practice.

In “ବାଟଖୋଜା,” the river becomes a teacher of persistence, generosity and the search for a path. Its difficult journey toward the sea contrasts with lives spent choosing comfort. The poem’s later landscape of cement sharpens this contrast into an ecological warning, before returning to the possibility of a living spring within each person.
